messages:
nora (customer-success): Hey, we've got a customer reporting ~300ms extra latency and US egress billing. They say EU traffic is hitting us-east. Sample request below.

nora (customer-success): curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'X-Client-Region: ["eu-west-1"]' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

maria (support): Thanks — can you paste the raw header value from the mobile logs or a HAR? Is it literally brackets+quotes or did the SDK encode it?

nora (customer-success): Raw header captured by the mobile network logger: X-Client-Region: [%22eu-west-1%22]

devin (sdk-eng): That %22 is a URL-encoded quote (\"). Looks like our mobile SDK v1.2.3 is serializing a region list into a header and the HTTP client then url-encodes the header value. So header ends up as [%22eu-west-1%22] instead of eu-west-1 or eu-west-1,us-west-2.

tom (router-eng): Router normalization currently expects a plain token or comma-separated tokens. We don't URL-decode header values today, so seeing the bracket/quote string means we treat it as an unknown token -> fall back to default region (us-east-1). That explains the misroute.

jay (sre): Reproduced on staging. Sent header X-Client-Region: [%22eu-west-1%22] and got routed to us-east. Router log excerpt: 

```
2026-03-16T10:12:33Z router[abc]: incoming X-Client-Region='[%22eu-west-1%22]' -> normalize() failed -> choose default us-east-1
```

maria (support): Customer impact: increased latency, cross-region egress charges. Case #5682. Any quick mitigation we can give them?

devin (sdk-eng): Short-term workaround: have the customer set a query param ?region=eu-west-1 or send the header without brackets/quotes (manually). We'll patch the mobile SDK to stop serializing single-region lists into header arrays. Patch target: v1.2.4.

tom (router-eng): Long-term fix: update router normalization to URL-decode header values, strip JSON-array brackets/quotes if present, then split on commas. Also add a metric for 'router.unparsed_region_header' so we can alert on this pattern. I'll open a PR for router/normalize-region.

jay (sre): Also propose a defensive fallback: if header present but unparsable, prefer IP-based nearest-region routing instead of defaulting to us-east. That will reduce cross-region hits while the SDK/normalizer fixes roll out.

devin (sdk-eng): Agreed. I'll prioritize an SDK patch and a short note to support with exact text for the workaround. ETA: 24h for SDK patch, 48h for staged rollout.

maria (support): I'll pass the workaround and ETA to the customer and include rollback instructions. Thanks :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR merged to staging: router/normalize-region - add URL-decode + strip-json-array (deployed to staging at 2026-03-16T13:40Z)

tom (router-eng): Canary deployed the normalization change to eu-west; monitoring routing metrics for 'unparsed_region_header' and routing error rate.

nora (customer-success): Customer confirmed removing brackets/quotes fixed routing. Closing once billing re-eval completes.
